# TeleBot
> A modern Telegram bot framework for PHP 8.2+. Provides a clean, intuitive API for the Telegram Bot API with DTO objects, update handling, and testing utilities.

## Docs

- [Installation](/telebot/installation): Getting started guide — install via Composer and create your first bot
- [Configuration](/telebot/configuration): Configure single or multiple bots, bot parameters, and manager settings
- [Objects](/telebot/objects): DTO representations for all Telegram API types with dot notation access, JSON/array conversion
- [Methods](/telebot/methods): Execute Telegram API methods using named arguments or array syntax, promises, error handling
- [Handling Updates](/telebot/updates): Process incoming updates via closures, UpdateHandler classes, webhooks, and polling
- [Testing](/telebot/testing): Use the `fake()` method to simulate Telegram API responses without real HTTP requests
- [API Examples](/telebot/api-examples): Practical code examples for sending messages, handling updates, and more

## Upgrade

- [3.x to 4.x](/telebot/upgrade/3.x-4.x): Migration guide from version 3.x to 4.x
